slides.heading: Seek care promptly if

caption:
Stretching every night, but your back is stiff again by morning?

That tight feeling is often your back being protective, not muscles that have shrunk. Stretching can feel good in the moment, but it's rarely the whole answer on its own.

Strength work builds your back's capacity for sitting, lifting and long days. Ease things with knee hugs and cat-cow, then add bridges, bird dogs and side planks two or three times a week. Hands-on care can be a helpful add-on.

Stiffness with fever, unexplained weight loss or pain that's worse every night needs prompt medical attention. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can build a simple plan with you. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
